comment: Which copies of the Hermes plugin scanner scripts/web/guard-scan.mjs runs. Each is fetched at the commit named here, so a CI run is reproducible. The gate decides what a verdict means (plan W3, amended for HERM-192): the fork, which is what the gateways run at install and update, is blocking and passes only on safe; upstream, which the fork tracks, is informational: it runs, its verdict and findings are printed and summarised, and only dangerous from it fails. These are the same commits the plugin repository pins in .github/scanner-pins.json: the plugin's own guard-scan job is the one that blocks an import, and this one has to say the same thing earlier. Move a pin here in a pull request of its own, at the same time as the plugin's. To try a scanner change before it is pinned, pass --scanner-root fork=<checkout>.
